name: io.github.vpsscouter/vps-scouter
title: VPS Scouter — Live VPS Hosting Prices, Renewals & Comparisons
description: Live VPS prices, renewal costs, comparisons and price index. No API key required.

tools.name: find_cheapest_vps
tools.description: VPS plans that meet the given minimums, cheapest first by average monthly cost over 24 months with renewals (estimated where the provider doesn't publish them). Supports Linux (default) and Windows VPS plans, NVMe, unlimited bandwidth, location and monthly billing filters. Prices are list prices in USD from each provider's own pricing page.

max_price_usd_month.description: Highest 2-year average monthly price in USD

location.description: europe, us, or a country, e.g. germany, netherlands, singapore, united-kingdom

billed_monthly.description: Only plans you can pay month to month

unlimited_bandwidth.description: Only plans with unlimited or unmetered traffic

windows.description: Only Windows VPS plans (includes the Windows Server license cost, checked by hand)

limit.description: How many plans to return, at most 25 (default 10)

tools.name: get_provider_plans
tools.description: Every VPS plan we track from one provider, with list price, billing term, renewal price, specs and data centers.

provider.description: Provider name or slug, e.g. hetzner, digitalocean

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of any two tracked VPS providers: verdict, entry prices, median cost per GB of RAM and per vCPU, cheapest plan at each RAM size (1 to 32 GB) and server countries.

provider_a.description: First provider name or slug, e.g. hetzner

provider_b.description: Second provider name or slug, e.g. digitalocean

tools.name: recommend_vps_for_use_case
tools.description: Minimum and recommended VPS specs plus the lowest 2-year cost pick and runner-up for a specific use case (e.g. wordpress, docker, n8n, coolify, supabase, minecraft, palworld, nextcloud, openclaw, ai-agents).

use_case.description: Use case slug or name, e.g. wordpress, docker, n8n, coolify, minecraft, supabase, openclaw

limit.description: How many fitting plans to return, at most 25 (default 5)

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: VPS price increases and cuts recorded on the providers' own pricing pages, newest first.

days.description: Only changes in the last N days (default 90)

tools.name: vps_price_index
tools.description: Market numbers: median price per GB of RAM and per vCPU, per provider, plus this quarter's findings on renewal increases and prepaid terms, each as one quotable sentence.
